label: late copy phase (last 2 outputs), weak and token-dependent
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original tokens or the delimiter, and concentrates on the last few copy steps: to_go <= 1 holds 79% of activation mass, to_go <= 2 holds 90%; never fires with to_go >= 6. Strongest on short sequences (L=3, rate 30%, top activations are L=3 at the final step, e.g. c b t <DEL> c [b]). Rate is depressed for L=5. Within the late window it is sparse (only ~23% of predicted steps fire) and modulated by input token identity (r, h, l, n, 0, k, z, j raise rate) without a clean rule, so precision is low.
